what: Pressing the menu button turns the screen overlay on like a CRT. It starts from a 1px horizontal line at center (brightness 3), the line holds at 35%, then opens to fill the screen (.6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), brightness → 1). Over it, noise grain jitters at .5s step-end, and after .2s a static burst flashes for .42s. The channel number, list and waveform come up with a .2s flicker after .5s. On open, the channel of the section above screen center (CH 01~) is shown. When a link is hovered, the number flickers and changes to that section’s number, and the waveform below is redrawn with a new period. The waveform is an 18%-wide light beam sweeping left to right in 3s (phone 2s) linear, drawing a new waveform, and the passed area stays as a faint afterimage (.35). On close it folds into a line at .4s (60%), then vanishes into a center dot. It closes on Esc or a link press.

options.cycles: Number of wave ripple cycles when the link has no data-cycles, default 7 (original per section 5·6·7·8·9·6)
options.narrow: Width at which waveform height drops to .22 and light beams shorten to 2s, default 37.5rem
options.--fx-cpm-on·--fx-cpm-off·--fx-cpm-wave: Length of one cycle of on, off and wave (css variable), default .6s · .4s · 3s

use:
CH 01

About
note: Fires fx:menu(detail.open) on open and close — stopping smooth scroll (Lenis) is left to the caller. For the noise texture it uses --fx-grain(url), and if missing the part generates a gray 128px noise and attaches it to html
